title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: Notice how the code creates new columns for each unique genre. This process is known as one-hot encoding. It transforms categorical data into a format that can be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction.

title: Checking for Unique Solutions
text: In linear regression, a unique solution exists if the matrix of features is full rank. Consider how one-hot encoding affects the rank of the feature matrix.

hintAnswer: The feature matrix must be full rank.
title: Matrix Rank and Unique Solutions
text: What condition must the feature matrix satisfy to ensure a unique solution in linear regression?
choices: The feature matrix must be full rank.
The feature matrix must be square.
The feature matrix must have more rows than columns.
The feature matrix must be symmetric.
